title: VPB GTA V Los Santos Weaponry
description: A pack for Vic's Point Blank that adds guns from Grand Theft Auto V
body:
Content pack for Vic's Point Blank that adds weapons from Grand Theft Auto V with custom animations and sounds!

Weapons added in the pack:

pistol mk1
combat pistol
micro smg
sawed shotgun
carbine rifle
service carbine rifle
marksman rifle
with this pack you can experience an iteration of the weapons from the famous game GTA V in minecraft.

some Attatchments are available only on creative mode and they're still being worked on.

HOW TO INSTALL:

1: Download the content pack

2: If you haven't already, create a folder in your ".minecraft" folder called "pointblank"

3: Drag & drop the content pack into the "pointblank" folder inside your ".minecraft" folder

DONE!

if this pack is well recieved i will add more weapons of the game~
